title: Security: patch sveltekit-superforms prototype pollution and adapter-vercel cache poisoning
description: Found by bun audit. (1) sveltekit-superforms <=2.27.3 has high-severity prototype pollution in parseFormData (GHSA-hwmc-4c8j-xxj7). Repo is on 2.16.1 and every superValidate(event, ...) call in src/lib/actions/card.action.ts, learn/, record/ and revise/+page.server.ts feeds attacker-controlled form data through it. (2) @sveltejs/adapter-vercel <6.3.2 has moderate cache poisoning (GHSA-9pq4-5hcf-288c); repo is on 5.4.1 and deploys to Vercel. Remaining audit hits are transitive dev tooling only (qs via cypress, brace-expansion via eslint/tailwind/svelte-check, valibot via the superforms adapter this app does not use).
design: sveltekit-superforms 2.16.1 -> 2.30.2, zod 3.23.8 -> 3.25.76, @sveltejs/adapter-vercel 5.4.1 -> 6.3.4. No Zod 4 migration needed: patched superforms peers zod '^3.25.0 || ^4.0.0', so staying on the zod 3 line keeps the existing zod() adapter import unchanged. adapter-vercel 6 peers @sveltejs/kit ^2.4.0 and the repo is on 2.5.18, so no kit bump. Three version strings, no code changes expected.
acceptance_criteria: bun audit reports no advisories against direct dependencies. bun run test and bun run build pass. Add, review and delete a card in the deployed app to confirm superValidate still works.

title: No CI: tests have never run on a push or PR
description: No .github/ directory exists, despite a pull_request_template.md. bun run test, check, and lint have only ever run locally.
acceptance_criteria: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs bun install, bun run test, bun run check, bun run lint on push and PR, and is green.

title: bun run lint is dead: eslint 9 with an eslintrc config
description: eslint 9.7.0 is installed but config is .eslintrc.cjs. npx eslint . exits with 'ESLint couldn't find an eslint.config.(js|mjs|cjs) file'. The lint half of the script has never run since the v9 bump. Prettier half still works.
design: Migrate to eslint.config.js flat config, or pin eslint to ^8. Flat config preferred, eslint-plugin-svelte 2.43 supports it.
acceptance_criteria: npx eslint . runs and reports real results (exit 0 or genuine lint errors).

title: Logout does not evict the in-memory session cache
description: src/hooks.server.ts caches {session,user} in a module-level object keyed by session id and returns it without revalidating. logout/+page.server.ts calls lucia.invalidateSession and clears the cookie but never deletes the cache entry, so a replayed cookie stays authenticated against the same warm edge instance. The cache is also never evicted on expiry and has no size bound.
design: delete sessionAndUserInfo[sessionId] on logout, and store expiry alongside the entry so stale ones are skipped.
acceptance_criteria: Log in, log out, replay the old cookie against the same running server: redirects to / , not /record.

title: Soft delete is logged as a review, inflating streak and heatmap
description: deleteCard (src/lib/db/tables/card.table.ts:85) is a db.update, so the log_card_update trigger in migrations/0001_plain_stingray.sql writes an activity row with action='UPDATE'. getCardsReviewed counts every 'UPDATE' row, so deleting cards raises the streak and paints the heatmap. log_card_delete never fires at all because nothing does a hard DELETE.
design: Add WHEN NEW.deleted = OLD.deleted to log_card_update, or have it write 'DELETE' when NEW.deleted=1. New migration, do not edit 0001 in place.
acceptance_criteria: Deleting a card adds no activity row with action='UPDATE'. Streak on /measure does not move after a delete.

title: /record renders every card with no LIMIT: 819 cards = 161KB of HTML
description: Measured by Lighthouse against production /record on 2026-08-28 with 819 cards. getCardsOrderByCreated in src/lib/db/tables/card.table.ts has no LIMIT and no pagination, so every visit server-renders the user's entire card history. Mobile results: perf 93 (vs 100 on the logged-out landing page), FCP 1.9s, LCP 2.3s, TBT 210ms. The HTML document alone is 161KB, larger than every JS chunk combined; total page weight 289KB. Main-thread work is 1.7s of which Style and Layout is 408ms and script evaluation only 242ms, which is the signature of an oversized DOM rather than slow JS. Desktop still scores 100, so this is currently mobile-only and degrades as the card count grows. Note src/routes/(protected)/revise/+page.server.ts has the same unbounded shape via getCardsOrderByNextPractice, though it is filtered by nextPractice < now so it grows more slowly.
design: Options, cheapest first: (1) LIMIT + offset or cursor pagination in getCardsOrderByCreated, needs a UI affordance on /record; (2) virtualize the list client-side, keeps one query but still ships 161KB of HTML; (3) infinite scroll on top of (1). Pagination at the query is the root-cause fix since it shrinks both the SQL result and the SSR payload.
acceptance_criteria: /record HTML payload stays roughly constant as card count grows. Mobile Lighthouse performance back to 100 at 800+ cards. Deleting and adding cards still lands the user on a correct list.

title: upgrade packages
No tests for calculateSuperMemo2Algorithm
description: The SM-2 scheduler in card.table.ts is the core of the product and has zero tests. Existing suite is 3 files: index.test.ts is expect(1+2).toBe(3), algo.util.test.ts covers streak math, CardReview.test.ts covers the review component. No server load or action is tested. @vitest/coverage-v8 is installed but there is no coverage script.
acceptance_criteria: Tests assert interval progression 1 then 6 then round(interval*easiness), reset to 1 on quality<3, and easiness floor of 1.3. bun run test green.

title: Runtime deps are all in devDependencies
description: package.json has no dependencies block. drizzle-orm, lucia, arctic, openai, @libsql/client, zod and the rest are all devDependencies. Works on Vercel today, breaks on any --production install.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime packages moved to dependencies; bun run build still passes.

title: No rate limit on the OpenAI generateCard action
description: learn/+page.server.ts ?/generateCard calls gpt-4o with no throttle. Authenticated, but any logged-in user can bill the key in a loop.
acceptance_criteria: Repeated generateCard posts from one user are rejected after a small per-window cap.

title: Env and setup docs are wrong in three places
description: .env.example is missing OPENAI_API_KEY which /learn requires. It says 'rename file to .env.local', README says .env, SETUP.md says .env. README is 5 lines and says 'npm run dev' in a bun-only repo (engine-strict=true, bun.lockb).
acceptance_criteria: One documented env filename. OPENAI_API_KEY present in .env.example. README uses bun commands and describes what remfo is.

title: No +error.svelte: every 500 renders SvelteKit's default page
description: No error boundary anywhere in src/routes.
acceptance_criteria: src/routes/+error.svelte renders a styled message with a link back to the app.

title: No LICENSE file
description: Public repo with essays/why-open-source.md and a 'star on github' nav link, but no LICENSE. Unlicensed means all rights reserved, nobody can legally reuse it.
acceptance_criteria: LICENSE file at repo root, license field set in package.json.

title: reviewCard 500s on a cardId that is not the user's
description: card.table.ts reviewCard takes cards[0] and passes it to calculateSuperMemo2Algorithm, which dereferences card.repetitions. A forged cardId in the review form yields undefined and a 500 instead of a 4xx.
acceptance_criteria: Posting ?/review with a foreign cardId returns a 4xx, not a 500.

title: record and measure loads use locals.user! with no session guard
description: record/+page.server.ts:13 and measure/+page.server.ts:4-5 dereference locals.user! . In SvelteKit the (protected)/+layout.server.ts guard runs in parallel with page loads, not before, so an unauthenticated request can throw a TypeError before the redirect lands. revise and learn already do this correctly with sessionExists.
design: Use sessionExists(locals) from src/lib/common.util.ts, same shape as revise/+page.server.ts.
acceptance_criteria: Unauthenticated GET /record and /measure redirect to / instead of 500.

title: Delete dead code: empty dirs, ROUTES.ALL, commented-out queries, cypress scaffold
description: Remaining half of remfo-zob after the unused-package removal. api-doc/ config/ test/ are empty dirs. ROUTES.ALL='/all' in src/lib/routes.util.ts has no route and no reference. ~50 lines of commented-out functions in src/lib/db/tables/card.table.ts (getCards, getCard, getTotalCards, resetCard, initialCard). cypress/ contains only the untouched scaffold spec (cy.visit('https://example.cypress.io')) plus a ~100MB binary dep - delete it or write one real login/record/revise flow. src/routes/(protected)/home/ holds one component imported only by learn, with no +page.
acceptance_criteria: Listed items removed; bun run test and bun run build pass.

title: tailwindcss 3 -> 4 migration
description: Verified from the v4 upgrade guide. CSS-first config (tailwind.config.ts only loads via an explicit @config directive), PostCSS plugin moves to @tailwindcss/postcss, @tailwind directives replaced by @import 'tailwindcss', removed utilities (bg-opacity-*, flex-shrink-*, flex-grow-*, overflow-ellipsis), renamed ones (shadow-sm -> shadow-xs, ring -> ring-3), default border color now currentColor, ! modifier moves to the end of the class, corePlugins option removed. Browser floor becomes Safari 16.4+ / Chrome 111+ / Firefox 128+. src/app.css and every component's classes are in scope.
acceptance_criteria: App renders identically on tailwind 4; no @tailwind directives left; postcss.config.js uses @tailwindcss/postcss.

title: arctic 1.9.2 -> 3.x is a breaking OAuth rewrite
description: Verified from arctic release notes. v2 breaking: createAuthorizationURL() no longer returns a Promise; validateAuthorizationCode() returns OAuth2Tokens instead of the old token object; it can now throw ArcticFetchError as well as OAuth2RequestError; scopes are no longer applied by default (including openid and provider-required ones); options.scope removed from createAuthorizationURL. v3 adds stricter RFC 6749 compliance. Affects src/lib/server/auth.ts and both files under src/routes/(auth)/login/google/.
acceptance_criteria: Google login end to end works on arctic 3: authorize redirect, callback, session created, profile+email scopes still granted.

title: lucia 3.2.0 is a deprecated library
description: Lucia was deprecated as a package; v4 is a migration guide, not a library. src/lib/server/auth.ts, hooks.server.ts, the OAuth callback and logout all depend on it. This is the largest future migration in the repo.
acceptance_criteria: Auth runs on maintained code (own session table + cookie helpers per the Lucia v4 guide, or a supported alternative). Login, logout and session expiry all work.

title: No security headers or CSP
description: Nothing sets security headers in hooks.server.ts or svelte.config.js.
acceptance_criteria: Responses carry CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy and frame-ancestors; app still loads (posthog, vercel analytics, cal-heatmap must be allowed).

title: Strip console logging from src
description: 33 console.time/debug/log calls in src/ run on every edge request, including console.log(completion.choices[0].message.content) in openai.service.ts which dumps model output into Vercel logs on every generation.
acceptance_criteria: No console.* in src/ except deliberate console.error on caught failures.

title: Delete dead weight: empty dirs, unused deps, dead routes, commented code
description: Verified unused: api-doc/ config/ test/ are empty dirs. postgres and @lucia-auth/adapter-postgresql have zero references in src/. cypress + cypress.config.ts + cypress/ contain only the untouched scaffold spec (cy.visit('https://example.cypress.io')). ROUTES.ALL='/all' in routes.util.ts has no route and no reference. ~50 lines of commented-out functions in card.table.ts (getCards, getCard, getTotalCards, resetCard, initialCard). src/routes/(protected)/home/ holds one component imported only by learn, with no +page.
acceptance_criteria: All listed items removed or, for cypress, replaced by one real e2e flow. bun run build passes.
notes: Verified-unused deps to remove (zero references outside package.json): postgres, @lucia-auth/adapter-postgresql, @tailwindcss/typography (tailwind.config.ts has no plugins array), @sveltejs/adapter-auto (svelte.config.js uses adapter-vercel), @iconify/types, @types/eslint, tslib, @vitest/coverage-v8 (no coverage script). Also happydom.ts + bunfig.toml + @happy-dom/global-registrator are leftovers from a 'bun test' experiment; the test script is vitest, which reads environment:'happy-dom' from vite.config.ts and resolves happy-dom only transitively. Replace with a direct happy-dom devDependency.
close_reason: Removed 9 unused packages (postgres, @lucia-auth/adapter-postgresql, @tailwindcss/typography, @sveltejs/adapter-auto, @iconify/types, @types/eslint, tslib, @vitest/coverage-v8, @happy-dom/global-registrator) plus dead bun-test wiring (happydom.ts, bunfig.toml); swapped in a direct happy-dom devDependency. Empty dirs, ROUTES.ALL, commented-out code in card.table.ts and the cypress scaffold NOT done - split out.

title: Dependency upgrade sweep, everything is mid-2024
description: svelte pinned to prerelease 5.0.0-next.195, SvelteKit 2.5.18, vite 5.3.4, drizzle 0.32, vitest 1.6 while @vitest/ui and @vitest/coverage-v8 are on ^2 (a major ahead of the runner). No Dependabot or Renovate. Components use export let so the Svelte upgrade is mostly mechanical but untested.
design: These are not 50 independent bumps. One coupled chain, driven by peer deps verified against the registry: vitest 4 needs vite >=6; vite-plugin-svelte 7 needs vite 8 AND svelte >=5.46.4; @sveltejs/enhanced-img 0.11 needs vite >=6.3 and vite-plugin-svelte >=6. So svelte prerelease -> stable, vite 5->8, vite-plugin-svelte 3->7, vitest 1->4 (+ @vitest/ui to a matching 4.x), enhanced-img 0.3->0.11 and svelte-check 3->4 all move together or not at all. @sveltejs/kit stays on major 2 (2.5.18 -> 2.70.3) and adapter-vercel 5->6 only needs kit ^2.4. Hard stop: kit 2.70 peer-depends on typescript '^5.3.3 || ^6.0.0', so TypeScript 7.0 is OFF the table until kit allows it; go to TS 5.9/6 at most. Independent of that chain: tailwind 3->4 (CSS-first config, @tailwindcss/postcss, @import instead of @tailwind, renamed utilities, Safari 16.4+/Chrome 111+ floor) is a real migration and should be its own task. zod 3->4 is mostly deprecations, but sveltekit-superforms 2.30 peers zod '^3.25 || ^4' and ships a separate zod4 adapter import path, so superforms and zod move together.
acceptance_criteria: svelte on a stable release, vitest and its plugins on matching majors, bun run test and check green, Dependabot or Renovate config committed.
